name: Gun control
statement: We need stricter gun laws, such as universal background checks and red flag laws.

name: Abortion
statement: Abortion should be legal and accessible.

name: Immigration
statement: Immigration enforcement and border security should be stricter.

name: Healthcare
statement: Government should expand access to healthcare, such as Medicaid expansion.

name: Climate & energy
statement: We need stronger climate and environmental regulations.

name: Taxes & spending
statement: Taxes should be cut, even if it means reducing government services.

name: School choice
statement: Public money should follow students to private or charter schools (vouchers).

name: Minimum wage
statement: The minimum wage should be raised.

name: Policing & crime
statement: Police funding and criminal penalties should be increased.

name: Election rules
statement: Voting should require stricter ID and verification rules.

name: Marijuana
statement: Marijuana should be legal for adults.

name: LGBTQ rights
statement: Anti-discrimination protections for LGBTQ people should be expanded.
